title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
A Magnesium do Brasil é líder de negócios em pesquisa, beneficiamento e comercialização de magnesita. Com a visão de revelar o potencial do magnésio e tornar-se referência mundial no desenvolvimento, produção e comercialização de soluções de magnésio com qualidade, atuamos com portfólio de nutrição animal, massas refratárias e aplicações industriais. Pertencemos ao Groupe Roullier, que movido por uma energia coletiva, atua internacionalmente há mais de 60 anos em 8 áreas de atividade (Indústria Alimentar, Agrosupply, Fosfatos Alimentares, Magnésio, Nutrição Vegetal para o Público em Geral, Embalagem, Algologia e Energias Renováveis).

Todos os nossos funcionários incorporam nossos valores diariamente: Espírito de Equipe, Segurança, Desenvolvimento, Responsabilidade e Inovação. Comprometida com o desenvolvimento e a melhoria contínua, a Magnesium do Brasil está em constante evolução, colocando a experiência dos seus colaboradores no centro de todas as suas preocupações de gestão.

Nessa função, você terá a oportunidade de:

Desempenhar um papel crucial na proteção da saúde e segurança dos trabalhadores. Terá a chance de aplicar seus conhecimentos e habilidades para identificar e mitigar os riscos de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro e saudável. Além disso, você poderá colaborar com diversas áreas da empresa, trabalhando em equipe para implementar políticas e procedimentos eficazes de segurança. Nessa posição, você fará parte do nosso time industrial em nossa fábrica em Jucás - CE, reportando-se à Coordenação de Segurança.

Você será responsável por:

  • Desenvolver programas de segurança específicos para ambientes industriais e de mineração, levando em consideração os riscos particulares associados a esses setores.
  • Conduzir auditorias de segurança para garantir a conformidade contínua com as regulamentações e os padrões de segurança.
  • Identificar e avaliar novas tecnologias e práticas de segurança que possam melhorar a eficácia dos programas de segurança no local de trabalho.
  • Investigar as ocorrências de segurança, analisando a causa raiz e definindo em conjunto com as áreas responsáveis, ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Apoiar na coordenação de equipes de resposta a emergências e a comunicação com as partes interessadas internas e externas.
  • Analisar dados relacionados à segurança e usar essas informações para tomar decisões informadas sobre melhorias nos programas de segurança.

Para ter sucesso nessa função, você deverá ter:

  • Nível Técnico em Segurança do trabalho.
  • Experiência na elaboração de Permissões de Trabalho e Análise Preliminar de Riscos.
  • Experiência em ministrar treinamentos regulatórios.
  • Experiência em análise de acidentes e incidentes, capacidade de identificar a causa raiz e atuar em conjunto com as áreas a preparação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Experiência com análise de dados, estatísticas e que tenha afinidade com planilhas, apresentações e a criação de documentos como procedimentos, manuais, instruções de trabalho, dentre outros.
  • Experiência em lidar com equipamentos de segurança específicos da indústria, como EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e sistemas de monitoramento de segurança.

Um ambiente cheio de desafios, com oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento. Nossa fábrica possui um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso e alegre, resultado da nossa cultura.

Por que juntar-se a nós?

Juntar-se a nós é atrever-se a fazer a diferença, a tomar iniciativas, a saber transformar dificuldades em oportunidades e a colocar o seu talento ao serviço de um coletivo, de uma ambição partilhada: Crescer Juntos é caminhar juntos na mesma direção.

Fundada em 1905, a Magnesium do Brasil foi 100% adquirida pelo Grupo Roullier em 2021 – multinacional francesa com faturamento anual superior a 4 bilhões de Euros, mais de 10.400 colaboradores e presente em todos os continentes.
Da extração ao tratamento da matéria-prima e com grandes esforços empesquisa e desenvolvimento, a Magnesium do Brasil tem por missão revelar opotencial do magnésio e tornar-se referência global nos mercados de nutriçãoanimal, fertilizantes, aplicações refratárias e outras aplicações industriais.
Após a aquisição de 100% pelo Grupo Roullier, sustentada por um importante processo de investimento em capacidade produtiva, a empresa consolida-se como fornecedor sólido e confiável para o mercado.
A Magnesium do Brasil mantém um firme compromisso com a responsabilidade sócio-econômica-ambiental, tendo um impacto significativo no desenvolvimento de seus colaboradores e das comunidades onde está inserida.
Espírito de equipe, segurança, desenvolvimento, responsabilidade e inovação são os valores que integram o DNA da Magnesium do Brasil.

O time de Interaction Platform tem o propósito de facilitar o desenvolvimento de experiências multiplataforma com alta qualidade e eficiência, reduzindo os custos e o tempo que levamos para evoluir os produtos e melhorar a experiência de nossos(as) clientes.

title: Student Mental Health Counselor – Wellness Center (2)
description:
Why the American University of Iraq – Baghdad?

Opening its doors in January of 2021, the new American University of Iraq – Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and the United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB will be a beautiful campus attracting students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

This position will report directly to the Associate Director of Wellness Center.

Job Purpose

The Student Mental Health Counselor provides counseling services and programming designed to help students in the AUIB learning community improve their emotional wellbeing and develop the personal skills needed for successful university life. Services include crisis intervention, problem-solving, evidence-based psychotherapy and mental health counseling, psychological assessment, psychiatric referrals, and education and prevention programs. This newly created position will be a key player in ensuring that the AUIB Wellness Center is accessible for students in the upcoming spring 2024 semester and that students will have access to the mental health services that they need. The Wellness Center will initially have a primary focus on the offering of counseling and psychological services but will also offer student accessibility services as well as act as a campus safety center where students will be able to report their concerns, seek emergency help, or go for crisis intervention.

Areas of Accountabilities: Main Activities

  • Providing clinical services (intake, individual, group, and emergency/crisis counseling, and individual assessment), outreach and consultation services, training, light administrative duties.
  • Maintaining an active caseload of weekly counseling clients, for students.
  • Providing an ongoing program of personal, substance use, psychological, crisis intervention, and other types of counseling services to the students.
  • Accepting referrals from staff and faculty for students suspected of experiencing emotional, psychological, or personal difficulties.
  • Collaborating with faculty, staff, and/or University offices (HR and line managers) to support employee wellbeing.
  • Providing input for professional staff development programs for the Departments of Student Life and Student Services, and other University divisions or departments.
  • Assisting in developing and facilitating wellness programming for residence halls and First-Year Experience classes on relevant topics as needed. Topics may include substance abuse, sexuality, relationships, depression, and stress management.
  • Assisting in designing and coordinating programs for faculty and staff on identifying and dealing with students struggling with substance abuse, depression, hostility, family problems, etc.
  • Assisting in the coordination of care for students who are receiving mental health treatment off-campus.
  • Designing and conducting special interest counseling groups as needed focusing on mental health needs of the student population (e.g., substance use, relationship issues, sexual assault, academic pressures, etc.)
  • Preparing and maintaining treatment records, reports, and other required documentation while ensuring the confidentiality of all student information.
  • Providing programs and resources in support of AUIB-wide wellbeing initiatives.
  • Fulfilling other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

A: Educational Qualifications:

  • A Master’s degree in Clinical Mental Health Counseling or equivalent, full licensure by the relevant licensing authority for psychotherapy/counseling services.

B: Minimum Experience:

  • No less than 2-3 years of counseling experience.

C: Competencies (Knowledge, Skills & Abilities):

  • Additional licensure in clinical addictions counseling is preferred.
  • Evidence of the ability to work effectively and collegially in cross-functional teams.
  • Evidence of ability to participate in planning and participating in cross-functional collaboration regarding holistic student wellbeing.
  • Evidence of strategic thinking and leadership.
  • Ability to speak and work in both English and Arabic.

Application Requirements for Positions at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover Letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

title: Engineering Manager, Payments
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

You're an original. So are we.

We're a company of people who like to forge our own path. We invented the blue jean in 1873, and we reinvented khaki pants in 1986. We pioneered labor and environmental guidelines in manufacturing. And we work to build sustainability into everything we do. Our brands stand for freedom and self-expression around the world.

Where we lead, others follow. For more than 160 years, we've used the strength of our brands to lead with our values and make an outsized impact on the world. We employ more than 15,000 people globally to support our great brands: Levi's, Dockers, Denizen, Signature by Levi Strauss & Co. and Beyond Yoga.

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead the Payments domain in our technology organization. This role is critical to ensuring secure, scalable, and efficient payment processing across our global e-commerce and retail ecosystem. You will be responsible for managing a high-performing engineering team that builds and operates payment APIs and services supporting credit cards, gift cards, Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), fraud detection, reconciliation, and in-store payment integrations.

You will drive technical excellence, architecture, and execution in alignment with our domain-driven design and direct-to-consumer strategy. As an engineering leader, you will collaborate with product management, security, store teams, mobile app team, website teams, and external payment providers to deliver robust, compliant, and scalable payment solutions . You will lead a highly skilled team of software engineers in a “you build it, you run it” environment. Your primary responsibility will be to drive your team toward successful and efficient delivery of high-quality software, while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You’ll ensure the team is aligned with company goals, adheres to best engineering practices, and upholds robust DevOps principles, including designing, building, testing, deploying, and monitoring the applications and services they create.

About the Job

  • Lead and Mentor : Provide technical guidance, career development support, and mentorship to team members, helping them to grow in both technical and soft skills.

  • Team Leadership & Culture : Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and trust where engineers feel ownership of their work and are empowered to take initiative.

  • Strategic Planning : Work closely with Product Management, UX, and other stakeholders to define and deliver on a roadmap aligned with company objectives and customer needs.

  • Technical Execution : Ensure that technical designs, code, and testing meet high standards. Facilitate architectural and design discussions to guarantee scalable and resilient solutions.

  • Process Management : Improve software development processes, implementing best practices for CI/CD, code reviews, automated testing, and deployment to streamline development and deployment cycles.

  • Ownership of Operations : Champion a DevOps mindset, where the team not only builds but also runs and monitors their own applications in production, ensuring reliability, availability, and performance.

  • Problem Solving : Facilitate solutions to complex technical problems, proactively identifying bottlenecks, risks, and quality concerns, and implementing measures to address them.

  • Performance Monitoring : Track and report on team performance, KPIs, and quality metrics, ensuring a high level of transparency and focus on improvement areas. Prioritize talent development and help with hiring new talent and grow engineers that are already at Levi Strauss & Co.

  • Experience Working with Global Companies: Work with teams around the world and support your global-capable platform.

About You

  • 10+ years of experience in product and/or platform engineering role, with tangible accomplishments in ecommerce or similar customer-facing digital experiences and APIs.

  • Proven Experience : Minimum 7 years of engineering experience, including hands-on software development and at least 2 years in a management or technical leadership role.

  • Technical Skills : Proficiency in any of Java, Node.js, TypeScript, GoLang, with a deep understanding of modern software engineering and DevOps practices. Deep knowledge of RESTful APIs, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native services.

  • Strong Leadership : Track record of managing and motivating a team, fostering a productive, collaborative, and high-accountability environment.

  • Process Improvement : Demonstrated ability to identify process inefficiencies and implement improvements that accelerate development without compromising quality.

  • Problem Solving & Decision Making : Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make informed decisions and prioritize effectively.

  • Stakeholder Management : Experience working with cross-functional teams, especially Product and UX, to ensure cohesive product development and delivery.

  • Operational Excellence : Commitment to maintaining high standards for operational reliability, availability, and scalability, as well as familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools.

  • Hands-on experience with payment gateways, acquiring banks, fraud prevention, and reconciliation .

  • Understanding of PCI compliance, security best practices, and fraud prevention strategies.

  • Familiarity with payment orchestration, tokenization, chargebacks, and settlement processes.

LOCATION : Mexico, D.F., Mexico

FULL TIME/PART TIME : Full time

Company Description
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras globais de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos, guiados por nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Job Description

O Gerente de Entrega de Serviços responsável pelo suporte remoto de TI é responsável por garantir a entrega eficiente e eficaz dos serviços de TI para atender às necessidades da organização. Essa função envolve gerenciar uma equipe de profissionais de suporte de help desk, coordenar processos de entrega de serviços e manter altos níveis de satisfação do cliente.

  1. Supervisionar as operações do suporte remoto de TI: gerenciar as operações diárias do suporte remoto, garantindo a resolução oportuna e eficaz de problemas de TI.
  2. Monitoramento de desempenho: acompanhar o desempenho do suporte por meio de indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) como tempo de resposta, tempo de resolução e satisfação do cliente.
  3. Gestão de incidentes e solicitações: garantir que todos os incidentes e solicitações de serviço sejam registrados, priorizados e resolvidos de acordo com os acordos de nível de serviço (SLAs).
  4. Melhoria contínua: identificar áreas de melhoria nos processos do suporte e implementar mudanças para aprimorar a eficiência e a qualidade do serviço.
  5. Gestão de equipe: liderar, orientar e desenvolver uma equipe de profissionais de suporte remoto de TI.
  6. Treinamento e desenvolvimento: oferecer oportunidades de treinamento e aprimoramento de habilidades para a equipe.
  7. Engajamento de stakeholders: construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders internos e externos, garantindo que suas necessidades de TI sejam atendidas.
  8. Reuniões de revisão de serviço: conduzir reuniões regulares de revisão de serviço com stakeholders-chave para discutir o desempenho do serviço e áreas de melhoria.
  9. Feedback do cliente: coletar e analisar o feedback do cliente para identificar tendências e fazer melhorias baseadas em dados.
  10. Estratégia de serviço: desenvolver e implementar estratégias de entrega de serviço alinhadas aos objetivos da organização e às melhores práticas ITIL.
  11. Gestão de orçamento: administrar o orçamento para operações do suporte remoto e suporte onsite, garantindo uma entrega de serviço econômica.
  12. Implementação de tecnologias: avaliar e implementar novas tecnologias e ferramentas para melhorar a entrega de serviços e capacidades de suporte.
  13. Gestão de riscos: identificar e mitigar riscos associados à entrega de serviços, garantindo continuidade de negócios e conformidade com regulamentos.

Experiência

  • Experiência com produtos SaaS (ServiceNow, Remedy, JIRA, etc.).
  • Sólido conhecimento de operações de entrega de serviços.
  • Conhecimentos: plataforma Windows, computadores pessoais baseados em Intel, tipos e funções de servidores, telefones IP, dispositivos móveis.
  • Idiomas: inglês fluente.
  • Educação: bacharelado em tecnologia da informação, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada.

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

description:
Company Description

At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects in over 119 offices in 50 countries worldwide.

Our team is dynamic, innovative and client-focused. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result our people get to work on some of the most exciting projects in the world.

Job Description

The Project Manager will oversee on-site activities to ensure successful project execution. Key responsibilities include:

  • Chairing and recording client meetings, ensuring all stakeholders are informed.
  • Weekly reporting on scope, budget, schedule, and construction-related issues.
  • Coordinating with the Client, Professional Team, Engineer of Record, and Contractors on project processes, risk management, and mitigation plans.
  • Facilitating attendance of Vendors and FAT/SAT processes, monitoring commissioning activities, and ensuring documentation is completed per schedule.
  • Managing defect resolution, handover processes, and integration plans.
  • Overseeing issuance and approval of RFIs, submittals, and critical documents to maintain the project schedule.

Additional support to the Project Manager includes:

  • Driving resolution of technical design issues and monitoring construction coordination.
  • Preparing reports for stakeholders and assisting with payment applications.
  • Supporting change management processes and ensuring adherence to commissioning tagging and quality standards.
  • Managing risk and change workshops, safety compliance, and General Contractor performance.
  • Ensuring timely preparation of handover schedules, manuals, and documentation.
  • Coordinating post-turnover works with operations and security teams.

This approach ensures streamlined project execution and compliance with required standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor in Civil Engineering
  • Lean Construction Certification and/or PMP Certification is a plus.
  • Relevant experience in similar responsibilities.
  • Mission critical experience a plus
  • Strong Verbal and Written Communication Skills in Portuguese and English.

Additional Information

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

description:
Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminum packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Primary Purpose of this Position:

TheSenior Analyst, Supply Chain Strategy & Transformation will be responsible for providing analysis and recommendations to support Ball Beverage Packaging South America Supply Chain Strategy. This will include providing investment analysis, closely with the Supply Chain Planning and Execution, Manufacturing, Engineering, Finance & Growth teams.

What will you be responsible for?

  • Supporting the analysis of strategic investment opportunities across our supply chain network, from scenario analysis to the investment approval submission.
  • Supporting footprint modeling (Ball and competitors) and optimisation scenario analysis.
  • Maintaining long-term planning models, including network optimisation and competitive advantage analysis.
  • Retrieves sales, production, inventory, and financial data from various systems and reporting tools to integrate into broader analyses.
  • Contributing to the long-term strategic planning cycle (3-5 years), closely collaborating with the Supply Chain Planning & Execution, Manufacturing & Growth Teams.
  • Collaborating cross-functionally with Finance, O&SC, and Growth teams to support cost-reduction initiatives.
  • Providing analytical support for major transformation and cross-functional Supply Chain cost-reduction projects.
  • Building and presenting recommendations for various stakeholder groups, including Regional Executive Leadership Team, Supply Chain & Operations Leadership Team, and the Enterprise Leadership Team. (data-storytelling)
  • Supporting the preparation for Regional Strategic Meetings and other strategic meetings throughout the year.
  • Supporting global initiatives aimed at driving efficiency gains across multiple areas within Supply Chain & Operations.
  • Manages regular team data maintenance, including but not limited to the footprint funnel in Excel, project financials, and recurring ELT project status updates.

Top 5 outcomes the role drives for Ball

  • Ensures analysis on potential investment or optimisation projects (as directed by the Regional Strategic Projects Teams) are completed efficiently and effectively, without over-whelming supporting functions.
  • Drive analytical insights into optimisation opportunities, but within our existing manufacturing footprint but also our customer base (both current and prospective customers).
  • Support the Regional Supply Chain Strategy & Transformation Director in providing strategic Supply Chain leadership to the respective function.
  • Support the identification and delivery of major transformation cross-functional Supply Chain cost-out projects.
  • Support the drafting of AFEs (investment approval process), so they provide a robust and coherent investment case.

What are we looking for?

  • An analytical individual with exceptional communication, organization, and cross-team collaboration skills
  • Minimum of a bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economy, Administration or similar.
  • English Advanced/fluent (writing and speaking).
  • MS Office Suite, with high proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Data management and visualization tools such as: PowerBI, Tableau, Qlik Sense.
  • Statistical modeling, VBA and Python. (desirable)

Analysis and Skills:

  • Analyzing and drawing insights from large datasets.
  • Producing effective presentations of financial/operational analysis. (data-storytelling)
  • Maintaining financial and operational models.
  • Working cross functionally and collaborative.

Founded in 1959 in beautiful Ventura County, the university has an enrollment of about 4,000 undergraduate and graduate students who come from across the nation and around the world from a diversity of backgrounds, cultures and faiths. As a federally recognized Hispanic-Serving Institution, Cal Lutheran is looking for candidates with a dedication to and success in working in diverse communities. The university is committed to an inclusive learning and work environment that values individual differences and respects each person’s dignity.

Basic Function

Under the direction of the Dean, Department Chair or Program Director, the Adjunct Faculty Member is responsible for providing academic instruction to students for the assigned graduate courses.

Provide academic instruction to students through lecture, lab, or performance courses; assess and develop cognitive abilities, communication skills, and higher order thinking skills among students through appropriate assignments and activities in one-on-one, classroom, and distance mediated instructional settings. Maintain current, accurate records of course enrollment, attendance, student academic progress, course curriculum, and student learning outcomes; prepare and submit data and reports related to course and student progress in a timely manner. E
Evaluate and select instructional materials such as textbooks, manuals, software, and tools in collaboration, as appropriate, with discipline faculty; order instructional materials according to campus bookstore procedure to ensure timely delivery. E

title: Software Engineering Team Leader Curitiba
description:
EBANX is a global fintech founded in 2012 with a mission to connect global and regional companies to consumers in Latin America. With its own technology and infrastructure, combined with in-depth knowledge of the Latin American market, EBANX allows these companies to connect to hundreds of payment methods in different countries in the region. And it goes further, creating results for businesses and simple shopping experiences for consumers.

From the beginning of our journey, we have an important mission: to give access . And this is not just about our products and services, but it goes through everything we are and do. We believe that it is only possible to innovate with diversity, so we cherish differences in gender, race, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion and age. Plurality is what makes our Big Dream possible.

We are called ebankers and we are changing the way people buy, connect, and live globally. Let's make history together?

You will work in a team of experienced developers and be responsible for maintaining a platform that processes millions of transactional requests every day. We cultivate an engineering culture that values and promotes sustainable quality, continuous delivery, high availability, quick feedback, and meritocracy.

As an EBANX leader you will be responsible for:

  • Managing a highly qualified and technical team;
  • Contribute and collaborate with the product areas and the development engineering team;
  • Have fun doing the management of technical teams and enabling the delivery of relevant products with global impact;
  • Create and send weekly reports on the progress of the team's activities to stakeholders;
  • Doing thorough code-reviews and help your teammates with complex designs and architectural decisions;
  • Testing and following your code to production continuously;
  • Working on strategic projects for EBANX;
  • Evolving and deciding the future of our payments platform;
  • A system of high availability (+ 99.9%) and with high throughput (100+ TPS), written in PHP, and MySQL (yes, it is possible :smile:). Don't know PHP? No problems, the important thing is to master the basics!
  • Mentoring and developing new talents;

What is indispensable for the job?

  • Proven experience of at least 5 years designing, implementing, and deploying software solutions to production;
  • Proven experience of at least 2 years leading a team of software engineers;
  • Interest in subjects such as data structures, concurrency, persistence, and distributed systems;
  • Expertise in git or any other collaborative version control system;
  • A vision for software quality, the evolution of systems, decomposition of problems and abstractions;
  • A great ability to learn new practices, technologies, programming languages and absorbing engineering culture;
  • Advanced English (read, write and speak);

What would we love to see?

  • Passion for software, you go to sleep and wake up thinking about how to make that part of the system more elegant or efficient;
  • Fluent English, we have customers from all around the world and it is commonplace for us to speak and write English when helping, supporting, and writing specifications with them;
  • Software development expertise in any complementary area to our core business, such as data warehouses, specialized development platforms, infrastructure automation, services provisioning, real-time systems, fault-tolerant systems, and mission-critical systems;
  • Experience with deploying to and monitoring a cloud infrastructure especially AWS.
  • Experience with computer networks, latency, package loss, routing optimization, monitoring, and problem-solving;
  • Full knowledge of SQL and relational databases;
  • Test-driven development: you don't even remember how to code without a very extensive test coverage; You often write the tests first and then the code.
  • Expertise in at least one functional or logic programming language -- besides SQL ;)
  • Comfortable with challenges of concurrency problems and has already worked in distributed and asynchronous systems;
  • Knowledge of data replication and conciliation;

What are we going to offer so you can do an amazing job?

  • Sustainable work pace: 40 hours a week of an accelerated but not frenetic rhythm - no marathons or sleepless nights; The focus is on working smarter.
  • The best tools money can buy so you can be productive in your work; (Macbook, Jetbrains licenses, Slack, Github, TravisCI, NewRelic, DataDog, ElasticSearch, Kibana, Tableau amongst others)
  • Deep and fast code reviews for any of your pull requests - You will also do a lot of them :)
  • Constant discussions about our practices and systems, everybody that wants to speak out is always heard and we are always open to new ideas, practices, and tools;
  • You will be free to dedicate part of your time to improve our systems and implement quality features that make us more efficient or less error-prone;
  • Frequent, fair, and transparent performance evaluations - all developers are evaluated with the same system and have access to the same career development opportunities;

EBANX offers:

  • A challenging environment, with opportunities to grow;
  • Casual office and flexible dress code;
  • Spanish, English and Portuguese classes;
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • Semi flexible hours (8 hours a day - Monday to Friday);
  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;
  • EBANX Flexible: monthly Day Off from February to November, birthday Day Off and Rest up Month - one month of paid leave every three years of work anniversary.
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents, and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX
  • Hello ebanker: psychology, finance and legal orientation.
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics store and more!

Follow us on LinkedIn and check out our Instagram to learn more about the #ebanxlife.

title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Join to apply for the Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you've enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.
The Canonical Kernel Team builds and maintains all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels for a variety of platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large-scale cloud environments. In your first year you will tackle serious initiatives, which include but are not limited to:

  • Optimized solutions for key Silicon and Cloud partner platforms
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Security hardening and exploit mitigation
  • Third-party driver integration and distribution, such as graphics
  • Expanded driver support for bleeding-edge PC platforms
We select candidates that are recent university graduates or early career professionals who are enthusiastic to develop kernel-level software in multiple areas including security updates, patching, and testing. The successful candidate will have a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing and able to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.
These are full-time positions available to prospective or recently graduated students.
Location: We have home-based Kernel Teams in every timezone.
The role entails
  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers
What we are looking for in you
  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length
Nice-to-have skills
  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

O Ninja do Excel nasceu em 2014, como um projeto pessoal do nosso fundador Edson Cavalcante, com o objetivo de ensinar Excel online para iniciantes. Hoje, 11 anos depois, o que começou como um projeto pessoal, se transformou em uma das maiores escolas de habilidades técnicas da América Latina, com mais de 155 mil alunos em 15 países e clientes como McDonald's, Bosch, Mercedes, Brasil Agro, Honda, Metro, entre outros. E não vamos parar por aí. Estamos em constante crescimento. Nosso objetivo é transformar profissionais em verdadeiros Ninjas das ferramentas mais importantes do mercado de trabalho, de uma forma prática, simples e direta ao ponto.

Quem Buscamos

Pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, que querem fazer parte da construção de algo grandioso e fazer a diferença. Se você é esse tipo de pessoa, venha crescer com a gente!

Buscamos alguém que vive e respira marketing digital, sempre à frente das tendências e com uma paixão genuína por criar conteúdos que não só engajam, mas também geram resultados reais. Aqui, marketing é a alma do nosso negócio, e o conteúdo é parte fundamental disso. Você será parte da expansão de uma das principais marcas de educação do Brasil, trabalhando ao lado de pessoas que vivem intensamente o que fazem. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de desenvolver campanhas, tendências e parcerias e pode dizer com orgulho: "Fui eu quem criou isso". Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho (Projetos)

Join to apply for the Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho (Projetos) role at NTS - Nova Transportadora do Sudeste

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.
Nossos Valores:

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga:
Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho que será responsável pela gestão de saúde e segurança das obras e projetos, incluindo identificação, mensuração e proposta para mitigação dos riscos de saúde e segurança e o atendimento à legislação vigente.
Responsabilidades:
  • Identificar, analisar e mitigar os riscos ocupacionais associados às atividades das frentes de serviço, implementando medidas preventivas e corretivas para reduzir os riscos de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais.
  • Elaborar e coordenar os processos/procedimentos de segurança de obras, seguindo o direcional do programa de integração de SSMA, elaboração de planos de ação, treinamentos e gestão dos requisitos legais, objetivando o cumprimento das devidas normas.
  • Atendimento aos requisitos legais de saúde e segurança relativos às frentes de serviços da NTS pautadas nas Normas Regulamentadoras, leis municipais, estaduais e federais.
  • Realizar treinamentos e outras comunicações para funcionários NTS sobre documentos internos e outros processos relativos a saúde e segurança, com objetivo de capacitá-los e conscientizá-los sobre a importância do cuidado ativo genuíno.
  • Realizar Integração de SSMA para prestadores de serviço antes do início de suas atividades para NTS, com o objetivo de apresentar os riscos das atividades, política e norma NTS e a importância de gerenciar riscos e desenvolver comportamentos seguros.
  • Realizar Briefing de segurança para todos aqueles que nunca acessaram as instalações da NTS, conscientizando-os dos riscos existentes em cada área visitada e como proceder em emergências.
  • Contribuir ativamente na gestão do Sistema de Gestão Integrado da NTS, incentivando o processo de melhoria contínua, ajustando procedimentos para refletir a realidade de campo.
  • Atuar como suporte nos cenários de resposta à emergência nas frentes da NTS, participando dos simulados de emergência, definindo junto as áreas plano de ação eficaz para reduzir e/ou eliminar os perigos existentes nas atividades / instalações da NTS.
  • Seguir as diretrizes de gerenciamento de incidentes, de acordo com a classificações da NTS, disseminar alertas de incidentes com a força de trabalho do campo, principalmente quanto aos incidentes de alto potencial e suas tratativas.
  • Gerir as não conformidades e planos de ação das suas frentes, de acordo com os procedimentos NTS.
  • Seguir as diretrizes da NTS quanto ao gerenciamento de inspeções e auditorias.
  • Realizar inspeções e auditorias periódicas com objetivo de avaliar a gestão em SSMA.
  • Atuar conforme periodicidade definida no procedimento de observação de segurança (auditoria comportamental).
Requisitos
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes com veículo da empresa;
  • Experiência em construção civil e projetos;
  • Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho completo.
Oferecemos:
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa-auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio-medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale-presente, Vale-transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo:
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
E tapas do Processo Seletivo:
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que contribui para o desenvolvimento do Brasil, garantindo o transporte seguro e sustentável de gás natural.
Venha transportar o futuro conosco!

Regulatory Affairs and Government Relations Manager

  • Full-time

Entain is one of the world’s largest sports betting and gaming groups, operating both online and in the retail sector. With offices across five continents and licences in more than 30 countries, we operate some of the most well-known and iconic brands in the industry with more than 250 years of combined history – names such as bwin, Sportingbet, and Betboo.

In an increasingly complex regulatory and policy environment, we seek a candidate with a deep understanding of the regulatory and political landscape in Brazil to coordinate Entain’s regulatory engagement and public affairs work in the country. As part of our Global Regulatory Affairs team, reporting to the Senior Regulatory Affairs Manager (Latam & Iberia), you will contribute to our goal of leading in safe and sustainable online sports betting and gaming. The Regulatory Affairs Team handles regulatory compliance, reputation management, risk mitigation, stakeholder engagement, and local partnerships.

Responsibilities:

  1. Lead the development and execution of the regulatory affairs strategy in Brazil, advising the company on emerging regulatory trends and ensuring alignment with business objectives and team goals.

  3. Represent Entain at industry gatherings, trade associations, and industry events.
  4. Anticipate and address critical regulatory challenges in Brazil, shaping the regulatory landscape through strategic stakeholder engagement.
  5. Review and analyze legislative and regulatory proposals to understand their impact on Entain and communicate these challenges clearly to internal teams.
  6. Collaborate with Compliance, Commercial, Tax, AML, and Licensing teams to address regulatory threats.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in public policy, political sciences, law, international relations, or related fields.
  • 5+ years of experience in regulatory affairs, government affairs, strategic consultancy, or public affairs.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil's political system, legislative processes, environment, and cultural landscape.
  • Knowledge of regulatory issues related to sports betting/gambling, including safer gambling, advertising, AML, and betting integrity.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in Portuguese and English.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Post-graduate qualification in law, political sciences, or regulatory affairs.
  • Experience in political consultancy, public affairs, or within the gambling industry.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience collaborating with complex teams across different global locations.

At Entain, we value diversity, equity, and inclusion, striving to create a supportive environment where all individuals feel valued and respected. description:
Overview

Nós somos KeminSomos visionários que veem as coisas de forma diferente e são inspirados pelo mundo que nos rodeia. Há mais de meio século que nos dedicamos a utilizar a ciência aplicada para melhorar a qualidade de vida.Somos um fabricante global de ingredientes que se esforça todos os dias para transformar de forma sustentável a qualidade de vida de 80% da população mundial com seus produtos e serviços.Por mais de meio século, a Kemin tem se dedicado a usar a ciência aplicada para enfrentar os desafios da indústria e oferecer soluções de produtos a clientes em mais de 120 países. A Kemin fornece ingredientes para alimentar uma população crescente com seu compromisso com a qualidade, segurança e eficácia de alimentos, rações e produtos relacionados à saúde para clientes em todo o mundo.Fundada em 1961, a Kemin é uma empresa privada, de propriedade e operação familiar, com mais de 2.800 funcionários globais e operações em 90 países, incluindo instalações de fabricação na Bélgica, Brasil, China, Índia, Itália, Rússia, San Marino, Cingapura, África do Sul e Estados Unidos.

O objetivo desta posição é assegurar que os processos da Kemin estejam dentro da legislação vigente, cumprindo com todas as obrigações pertinentes a Saúde, Meio Ambiente e Segurança do Trabalho. Propor alternativas de melhorias de processos relacionados as áreas de sua responsabilidade, garantindo um ambiente seguro, confiável e de acordo com a legislação.

Responsibilities

  • Acompanhar a elaboração e a execução do PPRA – Programa de Prevenção e Riscos Ambientais e do LTCAT, avaliando os dados criteriosamente a fim de propor melhorias e adaptações de acordo com o negócio.
  • Acompanhar a elaboração e administrar o PCMSO – Programa de Controle e Medicina Ocupacional.
  • Administrar e acompanhar os Laudos Técnicos e Ergonômicos.
  • Propor melhorias e adequações relacionadas a ergonomia e segurança, visando um local seguro e confortável para os colaboradores.
  • Enviar os relatórios, registros e certificados obrigatórios aos Órgãos Públicos (Ministério do Trabalho, Sindicatos etc.).
  • Garantir e cobrar a utilização dos EPIs Equipamento de Proteção Individual e EPC´s (Equipamento de Proteção Coletiva) para os colaboradores e os departamentos, controlando a entrega e utilização, visando à redução dos riscos à segurança e integridade física do trabalhador.
  • Promover inspeções nos locais de trabalho, identificando condições perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como treinar e conscientizar os funcionários quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho.
  • Controlar e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, organizar a Brigada de Emergência, promover o treinamento de Abandono de Área, cumprindo a legislação.
  • Colaborar nos projetos de modificações prediais ou novas instalações da empresa, visando a criação de condições mais seguras no trabalho.
  • Pesquisar e analisar as causas de doenças ocupacionais e as condições ambientais em que ocorreram, tomando as providências exigidas em lei, evitando sua reincidência, bem como corrigir as condições insalubres causadoras dessas doenças.
  • Preparar programas de treinamentos técnicos sobre segurança do trabalho, incluindo programas de integração, conscientização e divulgação de normas de segurança, para o desenvolvimento de uma atitude preventiva quanto à segurança do trabalho.
  • Realizar a integração de Segurança de novos funcionários, bem como de prestadores de serviços.
  • Promover campanhas, palestras relacionadas com Saúde, Segurança e Qualidade de Vida no Trabalho e em Casa, com o objetivo de conscientizar o trabalhador.
  • Administrar, acompanhar e realizar o processo de renovação da CIPA em seus programas, estudando suas observações e proposições, visando adotar soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho.
  • Prestar apoio à SIPAT, organizando as atividades e recursos necessários.
  • Levantar e estudar os indicadores de acidentes do trabalho, doenças profissionais e do trabalho, analisando suas causas e gravidade, adotando medidas preventivas.
  • Preparar e enviar o reporte das análises de acidente.
  • Avaliar os casos de acidente do trabalho, acompanhando o acidentado para recebimento de atendimento médico adequado.
  • Atuar de acordo com as normas, leis e procedimentos internos vigentes do departamento e da empresa.

Qualifications

  • Formação Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Desejável formação Técnica em Meio Ambiente.
  • Desejável superior completo ou cursando em Engenharia de Segurança.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Conhecimento das legislações vigentes (NR´s e legislação trabalhista).
  • Conhecimentos em PPRA, PCMSO, LTCAT e demais documentos obrigatórios.
  • Realização de palestras e treinamentos.
  • Análises técnicas de documentos.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no segundo turno (13h às 22h50).

São Bernardo do Campo - SP

MISSÃO
Responsável por analisar e contribuir com o Planejamento e Controle comercial do Grupo Pereira, visando
favorecer práticas comerciais que garantam rentabilidade e competitividade para todas as unidades de negócio
da cia.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Conduzir os processos de suporte à equipe comercial na execução e análise de estratégias da área,
    através da elaboração e acompanhamento de KPIs (Key Performance Indicator) e demonstrativos de
    performance de fornecedores;
  2. Contribuir com práticas comerciais assertivas e compatíveis com os padrões definidos pela cia, através
    do monitoramento de negociações e acordos comerciais, validação de prazos, descontos e demais itens
    contratuais acordados, atuando em conjunto à área financeira;
  3. Prezar por práticas comerciais que gere rentabilidade e competitividade ao negócio, através do estudo
    de viabilidade financeira das negociações comerciais, análise criteriosa de orçamento de despesas e
    contratos;
  4. Promover planejamento orçamentário assertivo e compatível com planejamento estratégico do Grupo
    Pereira, através da análise de estimativas, precisão dos dados levantados, ganhos e perdas, e demais
    análises de contratos junto a fornecedores;
  5. Favorecer a recuperação de verbas contratuais, por meio da apuração de acordos junto ao fornecedor;
  6. Contribuir com o planejamento de renegociação de contatos, através de cronograma definido em
    conjunto com a área comercial;
  7. Dar suporte à renegociação de contratos, por meio da apresentação de resultados, perdas e ganhos,
    análises de oportunidades e indicadores da área;
  8. Contribuir com propostas e soluções de melhoria e inovação para a área, por meio de estudos e pesquisas
    de benchmarking e análise de tendências do mercado;

    acompanhamento dos contratos firmados e cumprimento das condições acordadas.

  1. Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Ciências Contábeis e
    áreas correlatas;
  2. Experiência com Gestão de Contratos Comerciais;
  3. Conhecimento em Pacote Office.

About Grupo Pereira

Fundado em 1962, na cidade de Itajaí, em Santa Catarina, o Grupo Pereira tem o propósito de "Ser um bom lugar para passar a vida, nos transformando, transformando as pessoas e o ambiente ao nosso redor".

Com 20 mil funcionários e 800 representantes comerciais autônomos nos Estados de Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, São Paulo e no Distrito Federal, o Grupo Pereira tem mais 125 unidades de negócio, sendo 31 lojas do Comper (rede de supermercados), 60 lojas do Fort Atacadista (atacarejo), 3 filiais do Atacado Bate Forte (atacadista de distribuição), 1 Broker (distribuidora da rede Nestlé), 23 lojas SempreFort (varejo farmacêutico), 5 lojas Pera Turismo (Agência de Viagens) e 2 postos de combustíveis.

Completando o ecossistema de soluções para o cliente, também fazem parte dos negócios do Grupo Pereira o braço logístico Perlog e o de serviços financeiros Vuon, que inclui o private label Vuon Card, com mais de 1 milhão de cartões emitidos, além de seguros e assistência odontológica.

Com a missão de oferecer uma experiência de compra positiva por meio de excelência no relacionamento com clientes, fornecedores e funcionários, o Grupo Pereira colabora com a sociedade por meio de diferentes programas socioambientais.

Join to apply for the HPC Software Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
HPC is an important and technically challenging compute domain, with specialised tooling and a very high expectation of precision, efficiency and automation. This role is for a software engineer to join our HPC team to deliver an outstanding HPC experience - from bare metal to public cloud - as part of the broader Ubuntu platform. We are looking for a range of skills and experience, and will work on everything from the kernel to Debian packaging, but the heart of our effort will be Python software development for automation of key software in the HPC sphere. Our focus is on delivering a world class experience for the operation of the HPC cluster itself.
You will be part of the team that delivers charms that deploy and manage the HPC cluster and provide HPC software packages.
To succeed in this application you must be outstanding at maths and sciences, have built high quality software, have learned about open source ideally by working on it directly, and be looking for an engineering role with a company that makes mission-critical products for the global market. You should also be familiar with the open source environment, and want to build products in partnership with a community. Ideally, you should have some experience of high performance computing environments and a desire to unlock HPC for the world.
For this role you must have experience with Python. Experience in HPC environments is a strong advantage. Familiarity with HPC hardware and software is also a strong advantage - delivering great experiences with Infiniband, RDMA, CUDA, MPI, Slurm, Lustre, Singularity and related technologies will be central to this team's work. It will also be advantageous to have experience with Docker image design and operations, and public cloud image design and operations.
Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA or the Americas regions
What your day will look like

  • Write high quality, rigorously designed Python software
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Contribute to technical documentation that define best practices for authoring high quality operators
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with writing modern, maintainable Python
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest and experience with two or more of the following: Linux, Kubernetes, Public cloud, OpenStack, LXC/LXD, Python, Go, Debian packaging
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience operating HPC clusters in production
  • Experiences with Infiniband, RDMA, CUDA, MPI, Slurm, Lustre, and/or Singularity
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, you will lead a team of marketing managers managing partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner for open source-based products and solutions. You will be responsible for maximizing the ROI of our campaigns supporting various partner sales motions.

The partner marketing team comprises talented professionals skilled in formulating joint value propositions, running lead generation campaigns, creating impactful messages/assets, and selecting effective channels through complex supply chains. They are passionate about technology, enterprise users, and advanced partner analytics technologies.

Canonical is a pioneer in open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We recruit globally, set high standards, and expect excellence. Most colleagues work remotely, and working here challenges you to think differently, learn new skills, and innovate.

Job Summary

This is a senior subject matter expert (SME) role to support the Maintenance Superintendent in the maintenance of all rotating equipment on the site. The candidate must be able to provide SME knowledge, experience, and leadership for this role.

Utilize their broad range of skills and experience:

  • Lead and manage routine and major services on Reciprocating gas compressors and Reciprocating Gas Engines.
  • Root Cause analysis investigations.
  • Provide SME expertise and knowledge.
  • Ensure maximum uptime and reduce business losses.
  • Execute strategies developed by the Maintenance Excellence Manager.
  • Create and implement safe, reliable, efficient plans for rotating equipment maintenance.
  • Introduce condition monitoring technologies.
  • Provide input for rotating equipment budget.
  • Coach and assess junior technicians.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and drive implementation of the maintenance plan and performance improvements.
  • Lead all reciprocating rotating equipment maintenance, corrective maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Lead major overhauls and interventions on reciprocating rotating equipment.
  • Extensive experience in fault finding on reciprocating rotating equipment.
  • Extensive experience in overhauling reciprocating rotating equipment.
  • Develop reliability plans for all rotating equipment.
  • Ensure all activities undertaken by the maintenance team follow the CreDan and regulatory HSSE standards.
  • Deploy condition monitoring tools and methods to improve reliability.
  • Improve equipment reliability and availability.
  • Drive production improvement for the plant through investigation of losses and deep understanding of rotating equipment performance.
  • Deliver main equipment overhauls against agreed plan and costs.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

  • A minimum of 15 years’ experience in a senior rotating equipment maintenance position in the oil & gas industry on reciprocating rotating equipment, specifically gas engine compressor packages.
  • A minimum of 5 years leading teams in maintenance and overhauls.
  • Comprehensive troubleshooting of technical issues is a must. Subject matter expert (SME) in maintenance techniques on gas engines and gas compressors and associated equipment.
  • Proven tuning and setting up of gas engines and gas compressors.
  • Mechanical Technical Institute educated.
  • Preferred candidate will have in-depth Waukesha 275GL experience, Caterpillar 3500 and 3600 series experience, and Ariel gas compression experience along with major overhauling experience.
  • Preferred candidate shall have extensive knowledge of the Waukesha’s-Ariel Compressor Package and ancillary systems, and shall have an in-depth knowledge of the operations and controls of packages.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Confira o que é preciso.

  • Interesse e afinidade com a área comercial;
  • Vivência na área comercial com vendas consultivas (outbound, pré-venda, venda, etc.);

O que é desejável, mas não obrigatório?

  • Experiência em gestão de contratos e relacionamento com clientes (pós-venda);
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Engenharias;
  • Experiência em empresas B2B de tecnologia.

O que você irá fazer no seu dia a dia e com o que irá trabalhar?

  • Atuar com atendimento em multicanais: e-mail, telefone, chat, tickets, chamados, videoconferência e, em alguns casos, reuniões/eventos presenciais;
  • Identificar e tratar leads qualificados, atuando tanto com Inbound, como Outbound;
  • Mapear como o processo de vendas deve ser estruturado em nichos específicos do mercado;
  • Realizar atividades de backoffice envolvendo documentos, contratos, cadastros, garantindo a solidez administrativa;
  • Realizar atividades operacionais de faturamento e outras demandas financeiras da carteira de acompanhamento;
  • Participar das execuções estratégicas de Growth e Produto considerando a visão e o comportamento do nicho de mercado.

Se interessou pela SYDLE e pela oportunidade?

Será incrível receber seu currículo e saber do seu interesse pelo nosso time! Cada currículo recebido é avaliado pelo nosso RH e, caso o seu seja selecionado, entraremos em contato convidando para nossa seleção. Então fique de olho no celular e no e-mail, combinado? Mas caso seu currículo não seja selecionado para essa vaga, não se preocupe! Você ficará automaticamente em nosso banco de talentos para oportunidades futuras.

Conte com a SYDLE!

Nossas oportunidades são para pessoas talentosas, independente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, classe social ou religião. Queremos crescer juntos e acreditamos que, quanto mais diverso e autêntico for o nosso time, mais rico será o nosso dia a dia. Dessa forma, buscamos ter um olhar diferenciado e cuidadoso para essa pauta nas nossas seleções. E, caso você precise de alguma adaptação especial em nosso processo seletivo ou se tiver dificuldades em custear seu deslocamento para participar das avaliações, conte com a gente e informe o RH ao agendar as etapas.

Confira nossos benefícios!

description:
TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Hardware Engineer, you will play a critical role in the design, development, and optimization of our cutting-edge hardware components and systems. Your expertise will contribute to a new generation of devices, developing new features and products from scratch, selecting components, and layouting PCBs. Always guaranteeing the reliability, performance, standard compliance, and scalability of our IoT products, and enabling seamless monitoring and management of industrial assets.

Responsibilities

Take ownership of hardware design projects, including conceptualization, schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout.

Develop innovative and efficient hardware solutions that meet project requirements and specifications, following standards such as IEC 60079 (IECEx) and IEC 61010 (Electrical Safety).

Define and execute test plans to verify the performance, reliability, and compatibility of hardware designs.

Adapt the project and provide documentation for telecommunications standards and certifications such as FCC, IFT, CE and ANATEL.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as software engineering, firmware engineering, and product management, to ensure seamless integration and interoperability of hardware components.

Troubleshoot hardware-related issues by investigating and diagnosing problems, identifying root causes, and recommending appropriate solutions.

Document findings, test results, and hardware performance metrics in a clear and concise manner.

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field.

Minimum of 5 years of experience in hardware engineering and electronics.

Proficiency in schematic capture and PCB layout tools such as KiCAD and Altium Designer.

Experience utilizing laboratory equipment and tools for hardware testing, analysis and troubleshooting.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey complex technical information effectively.

Experience with design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA).

Familiarity with hardware design for low-power and battery-operated devices.

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Live or have availability to move to Sao Paulo.

Bonus Points

Knowledge of programming languages, such as C/C++ or Python, for test automation and data analysis purposes.

Strong understanding of Antenna Designing.

Strong understanding of Telecommunication Technologies.

Strong understanding of AC/DC and DC/DC converters.

Experience with Hazardous Locations Certifications (ATEX and IECEx).

Experience with Telecommunication Certifications (FCC, IFT, CE)

COMPENSATION

• Competitive salary and stock options

• Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses

• 30 days of paid annual leave

• Education and courses stipend

• Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years

• Day off during the week of your birthday

• R$200 a month for remote work allowance

• Mental health support: we cover 40% of the cost of your therapy

• Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation

• Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.

• Up to R$5.000 bonus for referring new Blue Caps

title: Applications Consultant SAP LES Transportation
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Como Consultor de Aplicações você atuará na condução funcional/ técnica de projetos para a implementação de aplicações na Gerdau, com foco em SAP, sistemas voltados para processos Logísticos e Interfaces com Sistemas Especialistas.   • Ter olhar global sobre iniciativas relacionadas aos processos Logísticos, garantindo a convergência do uso de produtos e soluções;

Our Risk & Compliance team is dedicated to ensuring the security and integrity of our financial services by proactively identifying and mitigating fraudulent activities.
