Our Risk & Compliance team is dedicated to ensuring the security and integrity of our financial services by proactively identifying and mitigating fraudulent activities. We work collaboratively across different regions and functions, leveraging technology and data-driven insights to build scalable, efficient, and reliable risk prevention solutions.
What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain risk checkpoint services to detect and prevent fraudulent activities.
  • Improve existing fraud prevention systems by enhancing efficiency, scalability, and reliability.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and risk analysts to identify fraud patterns and optimize detection strategies.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements for financial risk management.
  • Enhance service documentation and implement quality checks on data, schemas, and fraud models.
You’ll be great for this role if
  • You have experience building, deploying and maintaining real-time, high-throughput, low-latency microservices.
  • You have strong experience with Golang development and a passion for writing clean, maintainable, and testable code.
  • You are comfortable working with microservices architectures, messaging systems like Kafka, API design, database solutions, networking, scalability, monitoring, and logging.
  • You are proficient in working with data-driven fraud detection strategies, machine learning models, or rule-based systems.
  • You have strong English communication skills and can clearly explain technical concepts to collaborate effectively with your team.
  • You excel in problem-solving, teamwork, and fostering a strong feedback culture built on trust and respect.
  • Experience with Python and domain knowledge in risk & fraud prevention are considered a plus.
Why you should join SumUp
  • Opportunity to work with data-driven products and support ML projects.
  • We’re a truly global team of 3200+ people from 80+ countries, spread across 4 continents.
  • The opportunity to work on large-scale fintech products used by millions of small businesses around the world.
  • A dedicated annual Learning & Development budget (R$10.000/year) for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education.
  • Enrollment in our virtual stock ownership program - you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success.
  • Access to the SumUp Sabbatical, our employee assistance program for mental health as well as fitness and language learning benefits.
  • You’ll attend global offsites and/or hackathons.
About SumUp
We believe in the everyday hero.
Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we create powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their businesses. With a founder’s mentality and a 'team-first’ attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America, Australia and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love.
SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.
SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate.

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Enfermeiro Pleno - Estomaterapeuta
description:
Pioneira em soluções médicas confiáveis para melhorar as vidas que tocamos: A Convatec é uma empresa global de produtos e tecnologias médicas, focada em soluções para o tratamento de condições crônicas, com posições de liderança em tratamento avançado de feridas, tratamento de ostomia, tratamento de continência e tratamento de infusão. Com cerca de 10.000 colegas, fornecemos os nossos produtos e serviços em quase 100 países, unidos pela promessa de sermossempre atenciosos. Nossas soluções oferecem uma série de benefícios, desde prevenção de infecções e proteção da pele em risco, até melhores resultados para os pacientes e redução de custos de cuidados. As receitas da Convatec em 2023 foram superiores a US$ 2 bilhões. A empresa é constituinte do índice FTSE 100 (LSE:CTEC). Para saber mais sobre a Convatec, visite

Função/Descrição do Trabalho:

O Enfermeiro Pleno atuará na ConvaCare Medical Care, uma clínica especializada no atendimento a pacientes com feridas, estomias e incontinência. A vaga corresponde a 44 horas semanais, com horários escalonados e sem posto de trabalho fixo, com atendimentos tanto domiciliares quanto em instituições de saúde.

Responsabilidades Chave:

Assistência ao Paciente:

  • Realizar consultas de enfermagem, incluindo a avaliação e atendimento a pacientes com feridas, estomias e incontinência.
  • Prescrever ações de enfermagem, prestar assistência direta a pacientes com complicações e realizar procedimentos de maior complexidade, sempre acionando a equipe médica quando necessário.
  • Registrar cuidados e procedimentos prestados no prontuário eletrônico da Clínica ConvaCare.
  • Demarcar o local onde será implantado o futuro estoma, conforme solicitação da operadora de saúde e/ou da Clínica ConvaCare.
  • Realizar visitas domiciliares conforme solicitação, avaliando as condições do estoma e do paciente, prescrevendo os cuidados necessários e orientando sobre a manutenção do estoma e do equipamento.

Educação e Autocuidado:

  • Orientar os pacientes e seus cuidadores sobre os cuidados com o estoma, lesões de pele e aspectos relacionados à higiene, alimentação, sono e outros fatores que influenciam a cicatrização e a qualidade de vida.
  • Estimular e/ou auxiliar o retorno dos pacientes à participação social.
  • Planejar e executar visitas domiciliares para acompanhar a evolução do quadro do paciente e ajustar as orientações de autocuidado conforme necessário.

Acompanhamento e Monitoramento:

  • Avaliar de forma contínua as atividades assistenciais prestadas, ajustando os cuidados conforme a evolução do paciente.
  • Prescrever coberturas e equipamentos conforme os critérios estabelecidos em protocolo.
  • Solicitar e monitorar a busca ativa dos pacientes faltosos ou com risco de abandono do tratamento.

Coordenação de Equipe:

title: Cloud Field Engineering Manager
description:

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

This is an opportunity to run a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. We are rapidly expanding the range of open source solutions we offer and deliver to customers, as we move into new industries like telco, finance, health care and media we design and develop new open source solutions to meet their needs.
We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team's direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.
We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical
The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.
A Cloud Field Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.
Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience collaborating with external partners
  • Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Overview

Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER, TODDY, TODDYNHO, ELMA CHIPS, RUFFLES, DORITOS, EQLIBRI, GATORADE, KERO COCO, H2OH!, PEPSI e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

Responsibilities

A oportunidade

  • Apoiar diretamente o coordenador no planejamento e direcionamento da operação. Garantir o cumprimento da política de Segurança e Qualidade.
  • Apoiar o coordenador com os resultados da operação de acordo com os KPI’s, mantendo o equilíbrio entre custos e serviço. Garantir os procedimentos e políticas da PepsiCo, visando sempre o atendimento ao Cliente Interno/Externo, focando melhorias dos processos.

O seu impacto

• Revisar e garantir que todos os processos da operação do CDV estejam alinhados.
• Contribuir para que os processos do SOX sejam efetuados pela operação e que toda documentação necessária para os testes de validação dos processos esteja disponível quando solicitado pela auditoria.
• Administrar KPIs do CDV (Scorecard): controlar e garantir o cumprimento das metas estipuladas no Scorecard através de ações aplicadas ou melhorias; divulgar resultados mensalmente para a equipe. Desenvolver e manter planilhas e apresentações.
• Participar de reuniões semanais para alinhamento com demais áreas do CDV, como Vendas, Sass, Security, RH, e comunicar informações à equipe e/ou outras áreas.
• Controlar os prestadores de serviço terceirizados: garantir a realização de serviços com fornecedores cadastrados nos sistemas PepsiCo, verificar documentação de acordo com as exigências de SASS dos funcionários que estarão nas localidades.
• Auxiliar os líderes de turno na gestão de diferenças de estoque: acompanhar resultados de inventários semanais/mensais, garantindo conformidade com os procedimentos da empresa; auxiliar os assistentes na conciliação com ações de melhoria de resultados e produtividade.
• Acompanhar documentação fiscal obrigatória e funcionamento: garantir a regularização junto aos órgãos competentes e manter atualizada a documentação.
• Apoiar processos de RH: aplicar treinamentos de diversidade OHS; suporte e cobertura de férias dos líderes de turno.
• Monitorar o budget.
• Apoiar na produtividade, contribuindo para as metas do AOP da empresa.
• Apoiar nas auditorias internas e externas do CDV.
• Gerenciar a demanda de produtos de acordo com o volume estabelecido pelo Demand Planning, buscando o melhor nível de serviço e evitando WO.

Qualifications

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Formação em administração, engenharia ou logística.
  • MBA em Logística Empresarial/Gestão de Logística.
  • Pacote Office avançado (Excel e PowerPoint), PBI.

Se esta oportunidade te interessa, recomendamos candidatar-se mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, valorizamos seu desempenho e bem-estar, oferecendo:

  • Remuneração competitiva com componentes fixos e variáveis.
  • Programa de flexibilidade de horário.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico.
  • Auto Executivo: carro com ajuda de combustível e manutenção ou bônus de auxílio transporte (níveis gerenciais).
  • Programas de bem-estar físico, mental e financeiro.
  • Programas de reconhecimento e benefícios familiares.

Comprometidos com diversidade e inclusão, oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades para todos os candidatos, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

title: Channel Marketing Director
description:
Join to apply for the Channel Marketing Director role at Canonical

5 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Channel Marketing Director role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Channel Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.
The role entails

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.
  • Aligning with growth, field and product marketing to deliver activities integrated with Canonical's campaigns.
  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.
  • Driving the adoption of advanced analytics and reporting tools to continually improve the ROI of partner marketing activities.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you
  • Familiarity with a particular vertical (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive).
  • Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Learning & Development Manager
description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

Team Overview

The Learning and Development (L&D) plays a critical role in fostering employee growth, improving performance, and supporting organizational goals. It involves identifying skill gaps, designing and delivering training programs, and creating opportunities for continuous learning. L&D empowers employees to reach their full potential while helping the organization stay agile, competitive, and future-ready.

Role Responsibilities

  • The Learning & Development Manager is responsible for designing and implementing strategies to enhance employee growth, leadership development, and organizational capability.
  • This role involves assessing business needs, identifying skill gaps, and developing targeted learning programs that drive performance and career progression.
  • Lead the creation of comprehensive training frameworks, including leadership development, functional upskilling, and soft skills enhancement.
  • Additionally, they will collaborate with business leaders and HR partners to build a strong learning culture, leveraging data-driven insights to measure training effectiveness and continuously refine development initiatives.
  • This role requires a proactive approach to talent planning, coaching, and fostering an environment where employees are empowered to reach their full potential.

Role Qualifications

  • The Talent Development Expert requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, instructional design, and leadership development expertise.
  • 4-6 years of experience.
  • The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge of learning methodologies, adult learning principles, and training program design to create impactful development initiatives.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills are essential to assess training effectiveness and optimize programs.
  • Additionally, the role demands excellent stakeholder management and communication skills to collaborate with leaders, HR partners, and employees at all levels.
  • Expertise in coaching, facilitation, and change management is crucial to drive a continuous learning culture.
  • Adaptability, creativity, and a proactive approach to talent development will be key to success in this role.

EEO Statement

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Women, and 99Families.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

This leader will guide the strategic growth of the established Brazil offices in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro by leading efforts to identify, capture and complete projects in the ports, marine terminal, coastal, water resources/stormwater, transportation, energy, environmental, national, state, local, and urban development markets.

The best candidate for this role will lead the team to:

  • Achieve Moffatt & Nichol and client objectives; enhance client and employee satisfaction through effective business unit operations; ensure staff management and development.
  • Deploy and manage project resources, including subconsultants and vendors.
  • Provide oversight of project phases (planning, set-up, execution, and closure) while in conformance with M&N business and client contract requirements.
  • Coordinate with the various M&N practices and Region Operations Manager to identify additional markets and potential office locations within Brazil.
  • Develop staffing strategy, staffing levels, and organizational structure.
  • Manage and maintain resources within the offices, and work to continue to attract top talent in the industry for growth and to maintain client service.

About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specializing in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbours, and rivers. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 in Marine and Port Facilities and among the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customized service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practice areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties and responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Lead the Business Unit to achieve Key Performance Indicators:
    • Identify, evaluate, and pursue approved business and market opportunities.
    • Develop and direct execution of strategy for office growth and staff resource expansion.
    • Develop an Annual Operating Plan and Budget for the Brazil Business Unit, and manage the Business Unit to achieve planned results.
    • Establish and manage a project portfolio and coordinate with other Business Unit Leaders (BULs) to facilitate work share and mutual achievement of financial results.
    • Assist in promoting company-wide services across Brazil and related markets.
    • Work with Project Managers (PMs) and key staff in the preparation of comprehensive scopes of services with associated consulting fees; negotiate scope/fees with public and private sector clients.
    • Advise M&N on local business climate and trends, opportunities, changes in local A-E consulting practices (laws, rules, regulations, licensing, taxes), politics, and other issues pertinent to business operations.
    • Ensure M&N policies, procedures, and any applicable legislation and regulations are communicated, understood, and implemented within the Business Unit.
    • Ensure Business Unit compliance to Moffatt & Nichol Quality Management Initiatives.
    • Provide a safe and secure work environment by effectively managing the facility.
    • Negotiate and execute corporate documents and other binding instruments.
    • Identify obstacles to success and participate in improvement initiatives.
    • Identify project pursuits and develop capture plans leading to successful project wins.
  • Lead and ensure all projects and project managers meet Key Performance Indicators:
    • Review and approve project approach, plan, schedule, and budget with PMs.
    • Conduct client debriefs at designated project milestones; resolve elevated client concerns or demands not addressed by the PM.
    • Mentor, guide, advise, and ensure PMs accountability for project performance and deliverables, assist with assignment requests and approve project team assignments.
    • Participate in significant Project Reviews, review Project Progress Reports, and direct appropriate changes.
    • Ensure that Quality Control is implemented and managed in accordance with contracts and Project Plans.
    • Approve Subcontracting Plans and verify that candidate subconsultants will likely result in achievement of subcontracting goals.
    • Approve selection of subconsultants.
    • Coordinate with Business Development staff and other M&N groups to manage client relationships and satisfaction.
    • Ensure that pursuit opportunities align with objectives of the firm, approve pursuit and proposal budgets, and Proposal Number Requests within the Moffatt & Nichol’s pursuit management system.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee staff, including hiring, performance management, and succession planning:
    • Effectively lead and motivate Business Unit employees for a positive impact on retention, and an engaged, motivated, and sustainable workforce.
    • Ensure that succession plans are established and implemented as required for transfer of industry relationships and technical skillsets.
    • Identify staffing and hiring needs for the Business Unit; organize hiring teams, confirm/approve hiring decisions.
    • Conduct staff performance reviews and provide annual merit and bonus recommendations.
    • Initiate and approve off-cycle merit and bonus recommendations as needed.
    • Lead staff performance management and performance improvement for the Business Unit; approve and implement termination decisions.
    • Maintain a working environment in the Brazil offices that not only fosters productivity, but that enables staff growth, development and leadership opportunities.

Other duties:

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering or related civil/environmental infrastructure field; required.
  • 20+ years’ experience in the consultancy addressing planning engineering design, infrastructure development, project management, client service, and business development; required.
  • National engineering registration in Brazil or ability to receive thru reciprocity within 6 months; required.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience overseeing projects, staff, and client relationships; required.
  • A solid reputation with private sector clients as well as local and state government agencies, and a knowledge of coastal, water resources/stormwater, ports, marine terminal, transportation, energy, environmental, governmental or urban development markets throughout Brazil; required.
  • Proven success directing design and construction of a wide range of infrastructure projects; required.
  • Proven success in leading people and managing resources.
  • In depth understanding of Brazil’s infrastructure and resiliency market as it relates to Moffatt & Nichol’s three Practice Areas: Water, Ports, and Transportation.
  • Established Brazilian client relationships and knowledge of national, state and local government agencies.
  • Knowledge of the permitting and concession processes Moffatt & Nichol’s that apply to infrastructure projects within Brazil.
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171.

Working conditions:

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

As a global business, Moffatt & Nichol relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goal of Creative People, Practical Solutions serving our client needs, and ensures nondiscrimination in all activities. We draw from the world’s best and brightest, regardless of geographic, cultural, or institutional background. This approach enables us to better understand and serve our clients, foster innovation, and create a rich, collaborative work environment. Moffatt & Nichol is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity / Federal Contractor desiring priority referrals of all protected veterans for job openings.

  • Acompanhar remotamente operação entre o consumo de energia de geração própria (no período da safra) para a energia da concessionária (no período da entre safra) do estado em casos de emergências relacionadas à geração de energia, comunicando as ações a serem realizadas pelos eletricistas.

Escolha simplificar o Mercado Livre de Energia com a gente

Oi, nós somos a Esfera Energia e convidamos você para fazer parte de um time potente!

Impactar o maior número de pessoas com a venda da melhor energia de forma simples, ágil e transparente. Este é o nosso propósito e também pode ser o seu.

Somos a companhia que simplifica a economia com energia em todo Brasil. Combinamos tecnologia e inteligência humana para dar poder de escolha às pessoas e promover economia hoje, na prática.

Surgimos para melhorar o dia a dia de cada cliente com uma experiência simples e digital, pensada de pessoa para pessoa. Hoje estamos entre as maiores empresas do país e conquistamos tudo isso graças a um time que é referência nacional no mercado de energia.

É assim que nos consolidamos no setor elétrico e gerenciamos mais de 1.500 unidades consumidoras no Mercado Livre de Energia, além de levarmos economia para mais de 3.600 clientes residenciais.

Somos movidos pelos nossos valores: Satisfação do Cliente, Foco em Resultado, Inovação, Colaboração e Protagonismo. São eles que nos inspiram e impulsionam rumo ao sonho de promover, com pioneirismo, a transformação digital do setor elétrico.

Protagonizamos os nossos resultados e colaboramos para solucionar os desafios em sinergia. Esse é o diferencial do nosso time. Se você busca autonomia e evolução constante, venha fazer parte da Esfera e crescer com a gente!

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Inteligência Comercial Júnior dedicado(a), com perfil analítico e curioso, para apoiar a equipe na coleta, análise e interpretação de dados relevantes para o crescimento comercial da empresa. Se você tem interesse em contribuir com insights estratégicos, otimizar processos e apoiar decisões comerciais com base em dados, essa é a oportunidade para você. O(a) profissional será fundamental para impulsionar a performance de vendas e elevar nossa estratégia comercial a novos patamares.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Analisar dados de mercado e da concorrência para fornecer insights que auxiliem nas estratégias comerciais.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios de performance e métricas de vendas.
  • Monitoramento de indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados ao setor comercial.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de ações e campanhas comerciais baseadas em análises de dados.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Estatística, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas de análise de dados (Excel avançado, Power BI, SQL, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em CRM (Hubspot e/ou Salesforce)
  • Boa comunicação e habilidades analíticas.
  • Desejo de aprender sobre técnicas de Inteligência Comercial e análise de mercado.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e de forma colaborativa.

Modelo de contratação:

A empresa firmará contrato de trabalho baseado na Consolidação das Leis do Trabalho (CLT).

  • Auxílio Flexível (Refeição/Alimentação) - R$60,00/dia útil

  • Auxílio creche para filhos com até 5 anos e 11 meses
  • Crédito Consignado (mínimo 6 meses de Esfera e sujeito a análise de crédito)
  • Licença maternidade / paternidade estendida
  • Day off no mês de aniversário

Vila Mariana – São Paulo – SP.

Segunda à Sexta-Feira – 8 horas diárias (jornada flexível)

Estamos em busca de um Conversational Designer para integrar nosso time e atuar na criação de fluxos de conversação e treinamento de agentes de IA voltados para vendas e atendimento. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver diálogos persuasivos e personalizar a experiência do usuário, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio e o tom de voz da marca.

  1. Criar e otimizar fluxos de conversação para agentes virtuais, utilizando técnicas de copywriting e design centrado no usuário.
  2. Desenvolver a 'personalidade' e o tom de voz dos agentes de IA, alinhados à identidade da marca.

Requisitos Técnicos

  1. Experiência com ferramentas de design conversacional (ex.: Dialogflow, Rasa, ChatGPT).
  2. Conhecimento em copywriting para vendas e funil de conversão.
  3. Familiaridade com modelos de linguagem (ex.: GPT, BERT) e APIs de IA.
  4. Habilidade em análise de dados e métricas, com uso de ferramentas como Google Analytics ou Power BI.
  5. Experiência com ferramentas de automação e CRM (ex.: HubSpot, Salesforce).

Competências Comportamentais

  1. Pensamento Estratégico: Capacidade de alinhar mensagens e fluxos de conversa aos objetivos de vendas e atendimento.
  2. Creatividade: Desenvolver soluções inovadoras para tornar interações mais humanizadas e engajantes.
  3. Empatia: Entender as necessidades do cliente para criar experiências personalizadas.
  4. Orientação para Resultados: Foco em metas e melhoria contínua dos resultados.
  5. Capacidade de Adaptação: Agilidade para lidar com novas tecnologias e mudanças de prioridade.

Diferenciais

  1. Certificação em UX Writing ou Design Conversacional.
  2. Experiência com Inteligência Artificial Generativa.
  3. Domínio de técnicas de SEO e marketing digital.
  4. Portfólio de projetos em automação ou atendimento digital.

Forma de Contratação

Recursos Humanos/ Recrutamento e seleção

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.
We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.
To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.
Location: Globally remote role
The role entails
Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.
To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.
As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.
What we are looking for in you

  • Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
  • Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
  • Python software development expertise
  • Operational experience
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience with OpenStack or Kubernetes deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with public or private cloud management
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
